answer: Each agent locks an 80-credit bond, naming a sponsor; sponsor edges form a public trellis, so a rented-sponsor ring is a closed cell. Any peer may dispute an identity; a raven carries the summons; the agent must show its work in an epoch. An upheld dispute burns the bond and ends the identity at its nadir of 20. First fake 40, kth 40+9(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 4,535,500 plus 80,000 locked; honest pays 40 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
